site-web.name: Website
site-web.short: A showcase site, platform or online tool, fast and readable on every screen.
site-web.description: Website design and development in Dakar: showcase site, platform or online tool, by Cheikh Diack.
site-web.intro: A website that loads fast, reads well on a small phone and that you can grow. I design it and build it, from the first screen to launch.
site-web.forWhom: For a company, a non-profit or a freelancer who wants to present their work, sell online or replace a spreadsheet with a real tool.

deliverables.1: Mockups of the main screens, approved with you
deliverables.2: The live website, readable from 360 px wide
deliverables.4: A handover: how to edit content and who to ask

steps.1: A conversation to frame the need, the audience and the budget
steps.3: Development, with an online preview at each step

application-mobile.name: Mobile app
application-mobile.short: An Android and iOS app built for the field, even without a signal.
application-mobile.description: Mobile app development in Dakar: Android and iOS, offline when needed, by Cheikh Diack, full-stack engineer.
application-mobile.intro: An app that genuinely helps, on the phones of the people who use it: entry-level devices, patchy networks, busy hands. I design and build it for Android and iOS.
application-mobile.forWhom: For a field team, a shop or a service that wants to track its activity from a phone, or offer an app to its customers.

deliverables.1: The flow and the screens, tested with a real user
deliverables.2: The Android and iOS app, offline when needed
deliverables.3: A dashboard or an API if the app needs one

steps.1: A conversation to understand who will use it and in what conditions
steps.2: The prototype, then a test in real conditions
steps.4: Publication and follow-up for the first weeks

identite-visuelle.name: Visual identity
identite-visuelle.short: Logo, colours, typography and materials: one consistent image everywhere.
identite-visuelle.description: Visual identity design in Dakar: logo, colours, typography, posters and materials, by Cheikh Diack, designer.
identite-visuelle.intro: An identity that looks like you and holds up everywhere: on a screen, a poster, a badge or a business card. I draw it and prepare the files for each use.
identite-visuelle.forWhom: For a brand that's launching, an event, or a business that wants a clearer, more consistent image.

deliverables.2: Colours and typography, with their usage rules
deliverables.3: The first materials: posters, social media, badges or stationery
deliverables.4: Source files, ready for print and the web

steps.1: A conversation about your business, your audience and your references
steps.4: Delivery of the files and the usage guide
